journey.name: Fixed Price Bitcoin Requests
journey.description: Verifies fixed-price requests use the issuer's BTC quote while fiat display uses Bitkit's own exchange rate. Requires the linked fixture issuer and a regtest wallet funded for at least 100,000 sats plus fees, as described in README.md. This journey stops before broadcasting.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app with Paykit UI enabled and the fixture issuer saved as a contact and linked as identities
Have the issuer publish a current regtest P2WPKH address under identifier "btc-regtest-p2wpkh" with JSON payload {"value":"<current address>"}
Have the issuer send a new one-time request for amount "10", asset "usd", accepted identifier "btc-regtest-p2wpkh", and fixed conversion rate "btc" equal to "0.000021"
Verify the Payment Request confirmation screen (id "PaymentRequestConfirm") shows 21,000 sats, not 10 BTC
Wait for fresh validation and wallet preparation to finish; verify the same sheet stays open and its payment swipe control (id "GRAB") stops showing progress
Verify the fiat estimate equals Bitkit's current local valuation of 21,000 sats, rather than being forced to the issuer's 10 USD denomination
Dismiss the Payment Request confirmation screen without paying
Have the issuer send a new one-time request for amount "0.001", asset "btc", accepted identifier "btc-regtest-p2wpkh", and fixed rates "btc" equal to "2" and "btc-regtest" equal to "0.5"
Verify the Payment Request confirmation screen (id "PaymentRequestConfirm") shows 50,000 sats, not 100,000 or 200,000 sats
Dismiss the Payment Request confirmation screen without paying
